Use case: stylized-concept. ONE complete isolated small CLAN UTILITY SHUTTLE for an original Yautja-compatible 2.5D game city. This is an original logistics craft, not a named canonical model and not the selected flagship. No text or insignia.
Heavy curved charcoal-metal armored hull, restrained aged bronze ribs, broad central domed body, two low swept side pods, recessed amber alien sensor slits, dark opaque canopy instead of human cockpit glass. Three sturdy extended landing supports touch one level ground plane. No human airplane wings, rotors, wheels or rocket flame. Landed, engines off, no smoke, no landing pad, no terrain.
CAMERA: strict orthographic yaw ZERO from directly SOUTH, looking north from 35 degrees above ground. Nose points SOUTH toward bottom center; tail points north/up. Symmetric front/top view, substantial top hull visible, no side profile, no corner turn, no perspective convergence. Physical footprint 540 units wide by 380 deep, hull height about 120 units. Ground depth projects by sin(35 degrees). Overall painted craft wider than its projected height.
Native alpha background, entire craft and feet visible with generous margin. Landscape 1536 by 1024. Realistic hand-painted HD2D, materials matching basalt/bronze city, neutral upper-left light, shadows close beneath feet. No figures or extra objects.
